issues.description: Supplementary Tables 2/4 contain canonical marker gene lists that are not fully reproduced in the Markdown; only genes explicitly named in text or figure legends could be evaluated.
The paper reports nine major cell types and 41 fine-granularity cell types; the intermediate granularity count is not stated in the Markdown.

Candidates 5-7 and 20-22 represent the same DATP signature genes (KRT8, CLDN4, CDKN1A) from different source locations; both entries were included because each satisfies the marker criteria independently.

CD8 is used in the paper as a marker for CD8+ T cells, but because the CD8 protein marker does not map uniquely to a single gene symbol (CD8A vs CD8B) and the paper does not specify the gene, it was not added as a new finding.
